investment_theses.thesis: Long crude oil (Brent > WTI) into Q4 2026 as geopolitical supply risk premia persist and winter heating demand accelerates.
supporting_signals: CNBC: U.S. sends third carrier strike group to Middle East; Brent +4% on announcement.
CNBC: Europe winter energy crunch narrative; BP largest discovery in 25 years signals sustained exploration premium.
Middle East escalation risk (Netanyahu/Putin rhetoric from BBC) keeps backwardation steep.
investment_theses.counter_view: Global recession could crush demand; U.S. shale production ramps offset supply shock; summer storage builds ease winter pressure.
investment_theses.expression: Long USO or BNO ETF, or Brent crude futures (ICE Brent) through Q4 2026 close.

investment_theses.thesis: Long Fed uncertainty via short duration (long 2-year yield vs long 10-year yield steepener trade) because Powell removal threat + Trump AI/growth narrative will push near-term rate expectations lower while long bond reprices inflation risk higher.
supporting_signals: CNBC: Trump targeting Powell removal; court battles extend uncertainty through 2026.
CoinDesk: BTC tentative gains as rates drop; market is forward-discounting rate cuts.
Trump AI rebrand + memecoin enthusiasm signals pro-growth tilting of policy agenda.
investment_theses.counter_view: If Powell removal fails in court, certainty reprices long-end yields lower and steepener unwinds; or inflation data could flip narrative to higher-for-longer rates.
investment_theses.expression: Long 2-year Treasury yield, short 10-year Treasury yield (steepener); or TLT (20+ year bonds) short vs IEF (7-10 year) long.

investment_theses.thesis: Long Nike (NKE) calls with 6-12 month expiry because China turnaround + restructuring cost-base compression create a recovery arc that equity markets are not yet pricing as imminent.
supporting_signals: CNBC: Nike posts disappointing sales and announces restructuring/layoffs; stock reprices down on near-term pain.
Restructuring often enables margin recovery in year 2; China reacceleration would be catalyst for multiple re-rating.
Valuation likely to compress further before inflection, but 2027 earnings upside underpriced.
investment_theses.counter_view: Consumer spending slowdown in U.S./Europe persists longer than expected; China competition intensifies; restructuring overruns delay profitability recovery.
investment_theses.expression: Long NKE 3-6 month call spreads (buy $65 calls, sell $75 calls) or synthetic long (Jan 2027 calls) on Nike.

investment_theses.thesis: Long the ETH/BTC ratio into year-end 2026 as SEC custody rule clarity + institutional on-ramps favor ETH infrastructure narrative, while Trump AI pivot creates narrative rotation from pure store-of-value to compute/smart contract utility.
supporting_signals: CoinDesk: SEC proposes new crypto custody rules for investment advisers and funds; this benefits multi-asset strategies (ETH funds launching).
Trump AI rebrand (SI = super intelligence) pivots narrative away from pure macro hedge to AI/compute infrastructure layer.
Evernorth IPO with XRP treasury signals institutional crypto asset validation; institutional flows favor diversified strategies.
investment_theses.counter_view: BTC narrative (anti-inflation macro play) re-accelerates under continued rate-cut expectations; ETH execution risk (staking complexities, rollup L2 fragmentation) outweighs institutional inflows.
investment_theses.expression: Long ETH, short BTC perps on Deribit or Bybit (1-1.5 standard deviation ATM calls); or calendar spread long ETH spot vs short BTC spot.

investment_theses.thesis: Short Trump memecoin momentum (TRUMP token and clones) into Q3 2026 because regulatory scrutiny + Trump dinner exclusivity corruption narrative + SEC enforcement will erode retail enthusiasm once hype cycle peaks.
supporting_signals: Cointelegraph: Trump hosting 3rd exclusive memecoin dinner amid corruption claims; media already flagging legitimacy risk.
CoinDesk: Another Trump memecoin dinner advertised; saturation of events signals peak retail participation.
SEC enforcement posture (custody rule proposals) suggests upcoming crackdown on unregistered token offerings tied to political figures.
